content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue while programming my [product_name] (without display). I am prompted for a "BM diagram password" when trying to upload or download the program, which is blocking further progress. Does anyone know how to reset this password? Best regards, [user_name]
That is a diagram password protection feature. If you do not have the password, you can only remove the diagram and its protection entirely by using [product_name] software.
Thanks a lot! That solved my problem.

analysis.insight_summary: The main user experience challenge is the password protection required for programming the device, which restricts uploading and downloading operations when the 'BM diagram password' is unknown. This protection can be confusing, especially for users working with devices without displays. The issue was resolved through the suggested software, confirming that password protection can be removed or reset using appropriate tools.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to reset or remove the diagram password while retaining existing configurations and restoring full access for programming the device.
